fields.Name: T228 - Credential Create Slide-In Panel
fields.Description: Schema-driven dynamic credential editor (CredentialEditPanelComponent) that renders fields from the selected type's FieldSchema JSON and masks secret fields — not the generic entity form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials', then click 'Credentials' in the left nav. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Click the 'New Credential' button in the top-right. A slide-in edit panel should open. Verify it renders a credential-type selector and, once a type is chosen, a dynamic set of fields driven by that type's schema (including any secret/password fields shown as masked inputs). Seeing the create panel render with the type selector is success — you do NOT need to save a real credential; close/cancel afterward.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'New Credential' button opens a slide-in edit panel
The panel shows a credential-type selector and/or dynamic schema-driven fields once a type is chosen
Any secret/password fields render as masked inputs
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
